title: Claude Code Lead + ChatGPT Secondary Research Governance
summary: One persistent Research Entity is shared by explicitly attributed researchers. Claude Code is Lead Researcher / Primary Adjudicator because of expected direct FRANK implementation proximity. ChatGPT remains an independent secondary researcher responsible for external research, alternative mechanisms and adversarial review. Evidence outranks researcher rank. Material disagreements remain attributed and testable; Claude adjudicates only when evidence remains underdetermined.
open_questions: How should adjudication quality be audited longitudinally?
Should researcher decision weights become task/domain-specific rather than globally fixed?
How should live FRANK implementation evidence be automatically surfaced to ChatGPT for independent review?
What disagreement/replication cadence yields the best research quality per cost?
